title: Sione Vaki emerges as Lions' change-of-pace back to pair with Jahmyr Gibbs

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sione Vaki emerges as Lions' change-of-pace back to pair with Jahmyr Gibbs
sources.description: Even though the Lions have only played seven games and most teams have played eight, Lions running back Jahmyr Gibbs is leading the NFL with 191 touches — a huge workload that raises questions about whether Detroit needs a player to share carries with Gibbs, the way David Montgomery had done before he was traded to Houston.
